notes: Unlimited-OCR-2_int8.litertlm of litert-community/Unlimited-OCR-2: baidu/Unlimited-OCR-2 (MIT; a 3.3B OCR model: the DeepEncoder vision tower, SAM ViT-B and CLIP-L, and a 12-layer DeepSeek-V2 mixture-of-experts decoder with DASH attention) converted to LiteRT-LM as a fast_vlm bundle that reads one 1,024 x 1,024 page per request and writes the page as layout blocks (label, box, content; tables as HTML, formulas as LaTeX). Published 2026-11-04 (Hub main 1989a269 at the read). Measured 2026-11-04 in the runs s26b, s26c and s26f (the published bytes).
quantization: text decoder (12 layers, DeepSeek-V2 mixture of experts; all 64 experts computed as two fully connected layers and summed with the router's top-6 weights) with INT8 weights in its linear layers (the DASH router's query and key projections and the position table stay float), FP32 activations declared for the GPU; INT8 embedding table; vision encoder and projector with FP16 weights; KV cache of 288 kept and 128 ring slots; one 1,024 x 1,024 page per request (a 279-token prompt)
